newsitem.title: UK: Gartmore wins Yorks TV fund mandate.
newsitem.headline: Gartmore wins Yorks TV fund mandate.

text.p: British fund management group Gartmore Plc said on Monday it had been appointed by Yorkshire Tyne Tees Television to run a 43 million stg fixed income portfolio.
Gartmore said in a statement the appointment followed a competitive tender. Gartmore said it currently has 8.0 billion stg of fixed income funds under management.
It said the Yorkshire Tyne Tees mandate was a specialist brief "primarily focusing on UK fixed income with an option to invest up to 10 percent in global fixed income fixed income securities".
